title: Transition
overview: The film unfolds as a journey, portraying the protagonist's travels from Madurai to Trivandrum in pursuit of an undisclosed goal. Along the way, the protagonist encounters various individuals who share their personal stories. These tales serve as chapters in the narrative, with each one inspiring the protagonist to formulate a unique perspective after its completion. The movie concludes with a contemplation on the subjective nature of right and wrong, leaving the audience in a state of dilemma.
